page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU positions this instance as a memory-optimized resource. It provides a balanced allocation of dedicated compute power and large memory capacity, which is suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial RAM without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
